headline: Avient Faces Earnings Test Amid Revenue Pressure Under New CEO
summary: Avient prepares for its upcoming earnings report as a new CEO takes charge amid ongoing revenue pressure.
why: Earnings reports during leadership transitions provide critical data on how newly appointed management addresses top-line challenges.
